title: Subscription for the Hooked Protocol (HOOK) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad Is Now Open
text: Fellow Binancians, Subscription for the Hooked Protocol (HOOK) token sale on Binance Launchpad is now open and will remain open for  five hours . Users can check their eligibility and commit their BNB to the  Hooked Protocol (HOOK) token sale  based on their past seven-day average BNB holdings. The BNB rate for the HOOK token sale has been set below.  The subscription period has been  extended for two hours  due to time conflict with crediting BNB to users’ accounts from Hashflow (HFT) Launchpool. Please note users may commit their BNB anytime during the subscription period, and have a fair chance in receiving Launchpad allocation as per the  calculation rules . After the subscription is complete, Binance will list Hooked Protocol (HOOK) in the innovation zone and open trading for HOOK/BTC, HOOK/USDT, HOOK/BUSD and HOOK/BNB trading pairs at  2022-12-01 14:30 (UTC) . Further information: 1 HOOK = 0.0003381 BNB or 0.1 USD (using a BNB price of 295.8 USD). Users will have five hours to subscribe by committing their BNB tokens between 2022-12-01 06:00 (UTC) and 2022-12-01 11:00 (UTC). Users must also sign the HOOK Token Purchase Agreement prior to committing their BNB. The maximum amount of BNB that each user can commit has been calculated based on their past seven-day  average BNB balance . Important:  Only BNB in user spot wallets can be used to commit. If your BNB is in other accounts such as Launchpool or BNB Vault, you will need to redeem them to your spot wallet first before committing. Please note that once committed, your BNB will be  locked  and you will not be able to redeem or access any other functions such as transfers, withdrawals or trading until final token distribution.  After the subscription period ends at 2022-12-01 11:00 (UTC), the HOOK token allocation calculation will begin and will take a total of one hour. The final HOOK token allocation results will be revealed at 2022-12-01 12:00 (UTC), at which point the respective BNB will be deducted from your already-locked BNB amount within 60 minutes. Once deducted, your HOOK and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Reminder: There is a hard cap of 15,000 USD (150,000 HOOK or 50.715 BNB) that can be allocated per user. For detailed calculation rules, click  here .  The Hooked Protocol (HOOK) BEP-20 smart contract is available  here . Launchpad Subscription Format FAQ Please note that Binance Labs has an investment interest in Hooked Protocol. Reminder: Users need to complete their account verification and also be from an eligible jurisdiction to participate in this token sale.  * Users from the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in token sales on the Binance Launchpad platform:  Belarus, Cuba, Democratic Republic of Congo, Iran, Iraq, New Zealand, North Korea, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, Puerto Rico, the Northern Mariana Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands), Zimbabwe.
